findings.motion: Question on acceptance of the conference committee report on S.2924, An Act fostering voter opportunities, trust, equity and security (Senate Roll Call #188, 37 yeas to 3 nays)
findings.note: She is listed among the senators voting yes on accepting the conference report for the 2022 voting bill. The bill text (https://malegislature.gov/Bills/192/S2924.pdf) sets out mail-ballot applications and ballots signed by hand, by a hand-drawn electronic signature or by a typed name for a voter with a disability. It lists a voter's last 4 digits of a social security or driver's license number only 'if available' in lists of detained people sent to election officials. The text names no photo ID rule for voting in person and no proof-of-citizenship rule.
